SIGNALS.name: Whale Insider
SIGNALS.summary: Reports Anthropic saying its Claude Mythos model designed highly efficient quantum circuits that could bring quantum computing within reach sooner.

SIGNALS.name: AGTP
SIGNALS.summary: Says Google announced on October 15 that inline source links will appear higher and more often in AI Overviews and AI Mode.

SIGNALS.name: DailyPapers
SIGNALS.summary: Reports Mistral released Timestral on Hugging Face, a family of time series foundation models for zero-shot forecasting; the 5M-parameter version is out.

SIGNALS.name: CGTN Europe
SIGNALS.summary: Citing German government sources, reports Germany is set to announce an agreement with NVIDIA next week focused on industrial AI. Unconfirmed.

SIGNALS.name: Anusandhan National Research Foundation
SIGNALS.summary: ANRF announces a second call for pre-proposals under its Maha AI-SE programme, run with MeitY, DRDO, other ministries, the Gates Foundation and Google.

SIGNALS.name: Artificial Analysis
SIGNALS.summary: Artificial Analysis says Muse Spark Open scores 39 on its Intelligence Index, making it the top US open-weights model it has measured.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI expands access to GPT-Rosalind for academic research through a Rosalind Academic Plan, with sponsored access for eligible labs at U.S. universities.

SIGNALS.name: OpenAI
SIGNALS.summary: OpenAI says GPT-Live-1.1 improves voices and accents in ChatGPT Voice, Codex and dots, adding French, German, Hindi, Mexican Spanish, Korean and Japanese. API access is coming soon.

SIGNALS.name: AI at Meta
SIGNALS.summary: Meta released Muse Spark Open, an open-weight model with 816B total and 42B active parameters and a 1M-token context, built for coding and agentic work.
